name: s81hc_ctrncol_w_ref
why_floorplan: Per-column return slice, 34.56 tall (10-16 a4: a3 at 25.92 failed GRT-0116 only in the N-face output band, 1-4 M3/M5 tracks over in one gcell row at y 20.5-22.8, total usage 23-25%: output flop + hold stage per bit crammed into the top ~4 um; earlier 10-16: 12.96 failed DPL-0038 util 101% with recipe-2 pin flops on N+S) (one register stage, 1,140 b: valid, header, own + partner (column c+2) payload); partner inputs on the W side (columns 2/3).

job.purpose: New cth_ntc return slice replacing the 576.72-um ctrn strip: per-column bundles so every chain join stays inside its column.
job.hold_merge: cth_ntc parent component: the parent kit binds it after every child closes with native PASS; exactness = two-row chain proof + exact HC gate (RETCOL)

pin_regs.reason: Real RTL registers the boundary at its own stage (chain rd/rv -> rdq/rvq, y beat / cs relays, ybuf / psb captures, rdm / header / request / flag registers); a generic pin register would add a cycle to the fixed return calendar. hrq feeds the same-cycle merge (bank round trip) by design.

structural_change: ctrn (one register) split into four per-column slices with header / valid x4 and payload x2 replication; 0 cycles. | 10-16 a4: outline 25.92 -> 34.56 (core 21.6 -> 30.24 um: the N output band gets room for flop + stage depth), OT_OUTHOLD_ABSORB_INV=1 (QN INV + lead BUF/HB2/BUF output stage FIRM at the pin, the hbfd_rly_624 / CCR pr5abs pattern), N/S pins already alternate M5/M3 at 0.048 um offsets (plan tool), each bit keeps its x; same RTL, 0 cycles. Parent cth_ntc 874.26 -> 882.90 (rows below the slice keep their distance from the tile bottom: every parent leg length unchanged).
slot_change_request: New cth_ntc leaf (top-down parent plan tools/s81/hc_cthntc_plan.py, physical/s81_die_pins/v28_hc_cthntc: outline growth 10-16 a4: parent 576.72 x 882.90).
